steps.decide: The single claim the hero makes, traced to the recorded direction thesis
What appears above the fold at 390px within the height budget, in reading order
The primary action and the evidence placed next to it
Media strategy and its measured weight against the surface budget

rules.statement: One claim per hero; a second headline-sized statement splits attention and is removed rather than shrunk.
The hero states the direction thesis recorded in evals/directions; a hero that cannot be traced to a thesis is generic however polished.
At 390x844 the claim and the primary action both fit without scrolling; evidence may follow.
Any number in the hero is a registered claim or is absent; proximity to the call to action does not license a figure.
Hero media respects the surface budget and keeps the page at or above the measured baseline floor.

motion.noneReason: nothing has changed for the reader yet; a spinner would announce a detail
motion.reducedMotion: the poster frame remains until the first frame is decodable
poster swaps instantly to the first frame

transitions.trigger: keyboard focus moves to the action

stateMachine.staleResponseRule: a looping asset that fails to load leaves the poster frame and the claim intact; it never blanks the hero

refused.reason: nothing loads, so there is no loading state to show

sections.intent: State one claim and offer one action above the fold without promising anything the product cannot show.
nicheDifferences: Commerce heroes carry price context; portfolio heroes carry authorship
Docs heroes are usually absent and replaced by search
styling: One claim at display size; supporting line stays body size
Media respects the surface budget rather than filling the viewport
No gradient behind text for contrast rescue
a11y: Media that conveys meaning has a text alternative; decorative media is hidden from AT
responsive: Claim and action both visible at 390x844 without scrolling
copy: Numbers must be registered claims or absent
No superlatives that cannot be evidenced
alternatives: A quiet type-led hero is legitimate when the product is documentation
Splitting into two claims is not an alternative; it is a defect

references.label: Project convention: hero claim traces to the direction thesis (T0400)

acceptance: Claim readable at 200% zoom without horizontal scroll
failureCases: Second headline competes with the first
Evidence figure with no claim id
